text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered - P1 - model-catalog routing error spike. Incident INC-2026-1147. Error rate 5xx > 7% over 3m for route 'text-gen-latest' (service model-catalog).

pagerduty: Assigned to maria (oncall) — escalation policy: eng-oncall -> eng-sre.

maria (oncall): ack — I'm taking this. pulling logs and runbook now. @jon if you can stand by for a rollback/route change.

maria (oncall): quick snapshot from the model server logs: repeated failures when loading tokenizer for revision rev-2026-11-b. Errors look like "tokenizer mismatch: expected bpe_v2, got bpe_v1" and some downstream decode exceptions.

alex (runtime): confirmed. The alias 'text-gen-latest' was auto-updated during yesterday's model onboarding and the revision that got pointed is a quantized rev with an older tokenizer. Metadata mismatch. I can see the alias mapping here: 
```
alias: text-gen-latest
mapped_revision: rev-2026-11-b
expected_tokenizer: tokenizer-bpe-v2
actual_tokenizer: tokenizer-bpe-v1
```

jon (sre): runbook ref: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-routing#tokenizer-mismatch|runbook - tokenizer mismatch>. Recommended mitigations: 1) remove alias mapping, 2) route traffic to fallback revision, 3) restart model server pods if they have cached KV.

maria (oncall): performing quick mitigation — switching alias to known-good revision rev-2026-09-stable. Running command:
```
# repoint alias immediately
redwoodctl model alias set text-gen-latest --revision rev-2026-09-stable --force
```
deploy-bot: Deploy job queued -> job_id=deploy-8812. No template changes, alias update only.

maria (oncall): alias change complete. Observability: error rate dropped from 7.2% -> 0.8% in the last 90s. Latency back to baseline.

alex (runtime): I'm also opening a short-lived rollback of the problematic revision on the catalog and flagging the model onboarding job that introduced it. Patching the catalog validation to block tokenizer/metadata mismatches on alias updates.

jon (sre): good mitigation. We'll also purge KV caches on nodes that served rev-2026-11-b in case any lingering tokens/kv cause errors. Running: 
```
kubectl -n models exec -l app=model-server -- bash -c 'pkill -HUP model-server || true'
```

sanjay (prod-eng): running a quick grep to find which customers hit the bad rev. Looks like 12 customers had routing to rev-2026-11-b between 02:05-02:20 UTC; top impacted are acme-inc and bigbank-fin.

emily (customer-success): pinged Acme and BigBank engineering contacts. Acme reported intermittent 500s in their internal integration tests (non-prod), BigBank saw latency spikes but no data loss. I'll keep them updated and offer a postmortem.

maria (oncall): assigning follow-ups: 
- alex: patch catalog validator to reject alias updates with tokenizer mismatch (priority P0)
- jon: KV purge verification and a short cluster sweep for residual errors
- sanjay: full customer hit list and timeline
- emily: customer comms & impact note
- me: incident writeup and RCA start

maria (oncall): estimated mitigation time: 20m. Current status: mitigated (traffic back to stable revision), monitoring.

jon (sre): adding note — PagerDuty escalation was correct. Recommend adding a synthetic check that validates model alias -> revision tokenizer parity prior to any alias flip.

alex (runtime): quick patch in place to block future auto-updates until CI adds the check. I'll open PR and mark for hotfix.

maria (oncall): handing off to jon for overnight monitoring and RCA. I'm off-shift at 03:30 UTC — please escalate to eng-sre if error rate rises above 2% again.

jon (sre): ack and taking handoff. I'll keep the alerting muted for noise and set a specific alert for tokenizer-mismatch class for 24h.

emily (customer-success): summarizing message to customers: "We briefly routed traffic to an incompatible model revision which caused tokenization errors for some calls. Traffic was rolled back to a stable revision within ~15 minutes. We're conducting an RCA and will share timeline + mitigations." Will send now.

maria (oncall): thanks all. Closing P1 when RCA doc is triaged. Posting postmortem link when created. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty: Incident INC-2026-1147 status -> mitigated.

jon (sre): last checks green. Leaving a follow-up ticket: REDWOOD-1198 (catalog: add token-metadata check for alias updates).

maria (oncall): final note — please audit any onboarding jobs that auto-update aliases; we'll add a preflight validation in the CI pipeline.

-- end of thread (handoff complete)
